Refactor reference flowlines into reconciled reaches

Source: R/refactor_flowlines.R
refactor_flowlines.Rd

Refactors an NHDPlus flowline network by splitting long segments, collapsing short inter-confluence segments, and reconciling collapsed groups into a clean topology. Combines the reference accuracy guards with data.table O(n) performance. Two corrections over fast_collapse_flowlines: (1) a problem-headwater guard that marks confluence-adjacent headwaters as uncollapsible ("-9999") rather than forcing them downstream; and (2) a Stage 4/5 threshold split that applies mainstem_thresh to single-upstream (mainstem-run) segments and thresh to multi-upstream (confluence) segments.

Usage

refactor_flowlines(
  flines,
  split_flines_meters,
  collapse_flines_meters,
  collapse_flines_main_meters = NULL,
  out_refactored,
  out_reconciled,
  three_pass = TRUE,
  purge_non_dendritic = TRUE,
  exclude_cats = NULL,
  events = NULL,
  cores = 1L,
  warn = FALSE
)

Arguments

flines

sf data.frame with columns flowpath_id, flowpath_toid, lengthkm, hydroseq, levelpathid. totdasqkm optional.

split_flines_meters

numeric max segment length (meters).

collapse_flines_meters

numeric minimum inter-confluence segment length (meters).

collapse_flines_main_meters

numeric minimum mainstem segment length (meters). Defaults to collapse_flines_meters.

out_refactored

character path for split+collapsed gpkg output.

out_reconciled

character path for reconciled gpkg output.

three_pass

logical run collapse at 10%, 50%, 100% of threshold.

purge_non_dendritic

logical (unused, kept for API compatibility).

exclude_cats

integer/character IDs to protect from collapse.

events

sf point event locations (passed to split_flowlines). Their geometry also determines which reach outlets a collapse may not merge away.

cores

integer cores for parallel split (uses future/furrr when >1).

warn

logical print progress messages.

Value

invisibly returns list(refactored, reconciled) as sf data.frames.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
flines <- sf::st_read("reference_01.gpkg", "flowpaths")
out <- refactor_flowlines(flines,
                          split_flines_meters    = 2000,
                          collapse_flines_meters = 1000,
                          out_refactored = "refactored.gpkg",
                          out_reconciled = "reconciled.gpkg")
} # }
